name: 安装（敷设/连接/测试）服务

map.电缆敷设安装后绝缘电阻、导通电阻、耐压试验三项检测，依据GB/T 3048标准判: After cable laying and installation, three tests - insulation resistance, continuity resistance and withstand-voltage test - judge pass/fail per GB/T 3048
map.绝缘电阻温度修正：R₂₀ = R_t × 0.5^((t−20)/10)；判定: Insulation-resistance temperature correction: R₂₀ = R_t × 0.5^((t−20)/10); judge R₂₀ ≥ limit (PVC/XLPE/control 0.5, 10kV XLPE 1.0 MΩ·km); DC withstand-voltage test voltage U: rated ≤1kV→3.5kV, ≤8.7kV→2.5·U_N+2000V, >8.7kV→2.0·U_N; test time 5 min
map.绝缘电阻随温度升高而下降，故统一修正到 20℃ 比较；导体电阻以标准截面值 ×1: Insulation resistance falls as temperature rises, so correct uniformly to 20°C for comparison; conductor resistance is capped at the standard cross-section value ×1.1. The installation test passes only when all three of insulation resistance, conductor resistance and withstand voltage are qualified.
map.电缆安装敷设后的绝缘电阻、导通电阻、耐压试验三项检测工具，依据GB/T 3048: A three-test tool for insulation resistance, continuity resistance and withstand-voltage after cable installation and laying, auto-judging pass/fail per the GB/T 3048 series standards, with temperature-correction support.
map.按电缆类型与截面校核绝缘电阻与导体电阻。: Check insulation resistance and conductor resistance by cable type and cross-section.
map.计算温度修正与耐压试验电压。: Compute temperature correction and withstand-voltage test voltage.
map.输出安装检测报告用于工程验收。: Output the installation test report for project acceptance.
map.实测 10 MΩ·km @ 40℃ 修正到 20℃ 为 2.5 MΩ·km，仍不: Measured 10 MΩ·km @ 40°C corrected to 20°C is 2.5 MΩ·km, still not below the 0.5 limit, judged insulation qualified.
Cables rated 0.6/1kV and below take 3.5 kV test voltage; above 1kV compute 2.5×U_N+2000 (e.g. rated 6kV → 17.0 kV); duration is 5 minutes for all.
map.绝缘电阻随温度升高而下降，统一修正到 20℃ 才能与标准限值可比。: Insulation resistance falls as temperature rises; correcting uniformly to 20°C makes it comparable with the standard limit.
map.何谓安装检测合格？: What counts as a qualified installation test?
map.绝缘电阻、导体电阻与耐压试验三项均合格才判合格，任一不合格即需排查整改。: Only when all three - insulation resistance, conductor resistance and withstand-voltage - are qualified is it judged pass; any failure requires troubleshooting and rectification.
map.绝缘电阻测试依据GB/T 3048.5，0.6/1kV电缆绝缘电阻应≥0.5MΩ: Insulation-resistance test per GB/T 3048.5: 0.6/1kV cable insulation resistance should be ≥0.5 MΩ·km
map.导通电阻测试依据GB/T 3048.4，检查导体连接是否良好: Continuity-resistance test per GB/T 3048.4: checks whether the conductor connection is good
map.交流耐压试验依据GB/T 3048.8，试验电压为额定电压的2.5倍+2kV: AC withstand-voltage test per GB/T 3048.8: test voltage is 2.5 times the rated voltage plus 2 kV
map.测试前必须断电并充分放电，确保安全操作: Before testing, power must be cut off and fully discharged to ensure safe operation
map.绝缘电阻值受温度影响，需按温度修正系数换算到20°C: Insulation-resistance value is affected by temperature and must be converted to 20°C by the temperature-correction factor
